question: A alone can do 1/4 part of the work in 12 days. B alone can do 1/5 part of the work in 4 days. In how many days can A and B together can do the same work?
solution:
**Given:-**

A does 1/4 work in(Days) = 12 

B does 1/5 work in (Days) = 4

**Calculation:-**

As, A does 1/4 work in = 12 days

A does whole work in = 12 × 4 = 48 days

So, A 1 day's work = 1/48

Also, B does 1/5 days work in = 4 days

B does whole work in = 4 × 5 = 20 days

So, B 1 day's work = 1/20

⇒ ( A + B ) 's 1-day work

⇒ 1/ ( 1/48 + 1/20)

⇒1/[ ( 5 + 12) /240 ] = 1/(17/240) = 240/17 days 

**∴ A and B do the whole work in__ 240/17__ days. **
